segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בֶּן קׇרְחָה: לָמָּה קָדְמָה פָּרָשַׁת ״שְׁמַע״ וְכוּ׳.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korḥa said: Why did the portion of Shema precede» that of VeHaya im Shamoa? So that one will first accept upon himself the yoke of the kingdom of Heaven and only then accept upon himself the yoke of the mitzvot.

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יהושע בן קרחה: למה קדמה פרשת ״שמע״
